statement: C007's safe image certificate needs smoothness of the actual witness-incidence map over the Hodge branch. For a Hilbert-product producer, the exact sufficient local input is smoothness of each relative Hilbert factor over the ambient deformation base at its chosen point; finite fibre products and Hodge-branch base change preserve that smoothness. Fixed-fibre Hilbert smoothness, tangent surjectivity, or an unqualified normal-sheaf proxy are weaker data and are not substituted.
